title: Wire NoiseTruth + truth parquet into reconstruct_from_silver so synthetic-path metrics compute
description: Thread NoiseTruth from inject_noise through prepare_silver into reconstruct_from_silver and wire the __truth_id-aware metric functions (position_rmse_m, segmentation_prf1, boundary_time_error_s, coverage_ratio, deviation_prf1) so the sink's _PERSISTED_METRICS actually receive values for synthetic cells. Real-data cells remain NULL (no __truth_id). On the matrix process-pool path NoiseTruth cannot cross workers, so a minimal proxy is synthesised inside the worker from the truth parquet + silver.
expected_output: etl4/evaluate/metrics.py extended (segmentation_prf1, deviation_prf1, overloaded position_rmse_m / coverage_ratio, matched boundary_time_error_s); etl4/bench/run_experiment.py threads NoiseTruth through; etl4/bench/run_matrix.py accepts the 3-tuple return and is None-safe in _record; etl4/evaluate/__init__.py re-exports new names.
acceptance_criteria: ast.parse of run_experiment.py and metrics.py prints 'syntax OK'
from etl4.evaluate.metrics import segmentation_prf1, position_rmse_m, coverage_ratio, deviation_prf1, boundary_time_error_s prints 'IMPORT OK'
segmentation_prf1 P=R=F1=1.0 identical, 0.0 disjoint, 0.5 half-match precision
position_rmse_m 0.0 on identical NoiseTruth-join; ~111 km on +1 deg lat offset
docker exec etl4-postgres psql -c 'SELECT ...' returns 6 non-NULL rows for position_rmse_m, seg_f1, seg_precision, seg_recall, coverage_ratio, boundary_err_s on the latest synthetic run
pytest etl4/tests/ -q baseline preserved (32 pass, 1 pre-existing fail, 1 skipped)
